"Kirabhu yako inoda kushanyira muzinda wesayenzi wevana. Unoverenga chizivisiro uye unosarudza bhajeti.

n-k-k6-05.thinking.2: Kunyora patsva meseji kuti isagone kuverengwa zvisirizvo
n-k-k6-05.prereq.0: Unoziva 안 + chiito ne 못 + chiito
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi, uye utaure nenzwi zvese zvinoreva mutsara ungaita.

n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino '숙제를 다 안 했어요' yaireva chii?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Ruzivo runosarudza: mibvunzo 8 pa 10 yakaitwa, saka mutsara waireva 'kwete zvese'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Akaita zvakawanda uye akarasikirwa nemibvunzo miviri yekupedzisira.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Misere mikuru pa gumi i yakawanda kupfuura hafu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Mhinduro yake yechipiri inoudza kuti mibvunzo ipi yaakaita.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mutsara upi unofanira kunyorwa ne 유나 kuti mudzidzisi asagone kuuverenga se 'akaita zvakawanda'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '하나도 안 했어요' haisiyi nzvimbo ye 'chikamu'. '다는 못 했어요' i nzira yakajeka yekutaura 'kwete zvese'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uyu i mutsara une zvinoreva zviviri wakafanana nepamberi; haubvisi 'akaita chikamu'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uyu unonzwika se 'akaita chikamu asi kwete zvese', chinopesana nezvinoda 유나 kutaura.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.reflect: Cherekedza kuti mazwi akafanana akaramba akadaro uye ruzivo bedzi rwakachinja kuverenga kwako. Mutauri anoda kuva nechokwadi chekunzwisiswa anofanira kusarudza mazwi anobvumira zvinoreva chimwe chete.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.prompt: Mitsara ipi pakati peiyi inogona kunzwisiswa zvisirizvo nenzira yakafanana ne '숙제를 다 안 했어요'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga mutsara umo izwi rinoreva 'zvese' rinosangana neizwi rinoramba.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kutaura mutsara mumwe nemumwe uchifunga mamiriro maviri akasiyana uye uone kuti upi unoenderana nemaviri ose.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.b: Uyu unoti vaenzi havasati vauya; hauna kupatsanurwa 'zvese kana hapana'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.d: Uyu unoti vashoma vakauya; hausiyi 'hapana kana kwete zvese' yakavhurika.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.explain: '다' (zvese) inotevedzwa neizwi rinoramba inogona kuverengwa se 'hapana' kana 'kwete zvese', saka '손님이 다 안 왔어요' ine kuverenga kuviri kwakafanana.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mitsara miviri yeKorea (kutaura kunoremekedza), imwe neimwe nezve BASA RAKASIYANA (semuenzaniso basa rekumba, kuchenesa kana bhuku). Mutsara 1: hauna kuita basa rekutanga rakadini. Mutsara 2: waita chikamu chebasa rechipiri bedzi. Usashandise '다 안' kana '다 못' mumutsara upi zvawo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.0: Pa 'hapana', sarudza izwi rinoreva 'kunyange kamwe chete'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.1: Pa 'chikamu', taura kuti waita zvakadini (hafu, zvishoma, kusvika pane imwe poindi) kana kushandisa chimiro chinoreva 'kwete zvese'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu mumwe nemumwe unogona kuverengwa nenzira imwe chete bedzi here?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mitsara miviri inotsanangura huwandu hwakasiyana chaizvo here?

'Laibhurari yekwenyu yakaisa tafura nepositi.

n-k-k6-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga nhamba ne 명 ne 권

n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.c: Positi yakarurama, nokuti laibhurari ine vanhu vakawanda zvinoreva kuverenga kwakawanda.

n-k-k6-03.prereq.1: Unogona kuverenga zvizivisiro zvipfupi mu 해요체
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukatevera chirongwa chaMinah (민아) ukashandisa koupon iyi imwe yema Americano maviri China, chirevo chipi chakarurama?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Edza sarudzo imwe neimwe nemitsara yakadhindwa yekoupon: ipi yaunogona kusimbisa uye ipi yaunogona kupikisa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga mutengo wechirongwa nekoupon uye pasina, uchishandisa zvinotaurwa nekoupon bedzi.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.a: Koupon yakapera nemusi weChina, saka hapana kudzikisira.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.a: China i April 30, uye '4월 30일까지' inosanganisira zuva iroro.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.b: Koupon inobvisa 2,000 won pachinwiwa chimwe nechimwe, saka 4,000 yese.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.b: '1회 사용' zvinoreva kushandiswa kamwe pakoupon, kwete kamwe pachinwiwa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.c: Kuwedzera kumwe kudzikisira kunoita kuti kuchengetedza kuve kukuru kupfuura 2,000 won.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.c: '다른 할인과 중복 불가' zvinoreva kuti kudzikisira hakugone kubatanidzwa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.d: Koupon imwe inobvisa 2,000 won kamwe, kwete 4,000.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.explain: Nhasi i Muvhuro zuva rechi 27, saka China i zuva rechi 30, zuva rekupedzisira rinoshanda. Koupon i yekushandiswa kamwe uye haigoni kubatanidzwa, saka zvinwiwa zviviri zvichiri kuwana 2,000 won yakabviswa yese.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.prompt: Chirongwa i China anenge pa 3 p.m. pakafi iri pamberi pechikoro. Mubvunzo upi UNOSAPINDURWA nekoupon uye ungatadzisa chirongwa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Pamubvunzo mumwe nemumwe, tsvaga mutsara wekoupon unoupindura; dzima waunogona kupindura.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Chikamu chipi chechirongwa chisinganyorwi nemutsara upi zvawo wakadhindwa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.a: Koupon yatopa zuva rekupedzisira rinoshanda, uye China rinoenderana naro.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.d: Koupon yatoti inoshanda pamasampuro ese e 모아카페.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.explain: Zuva, nhamba yekushandiswa nemasampuro zvakadhindwa pakoupon. Mutsara wekupedzisira unosiya 'mamwe mamiriro' akavhurika, uye nguva yezuva i imwe inogona kukosha pakushanya kwa 3 p.m.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.prompt: Pindura 민아 muKorea (해요체 ine ushamwari). Gadzirisa zvinyoro pfungwa ye 4,000 won, uye ubvunze kana kukurudzira kutarisa mubvunzo uri kuvhurika.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvikamu zviviri zvipfupi: zvaunoziva kubva pakoupon, wobva wataura zvaunoda kuziva.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa kupera kunokurudzira kana kubvunza, sa '-(으)ㄹ까요?'.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura here zvinopiwa chaizvo nekoupon (kudzikisira kumwe kwe 2,000 won)?
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mubvunzo wangu i wechinhu chimwe chinhu chisingatauriwi nekoupon here?
